result.title: Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies
result.summary: Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central student. The anchor is held fixed within each block and refreshed from the student at block boundaries, so the population stays centered on a stable yet current policy and continues to supply diverse and reliable supervision as the student moves. In single-task test-time adaptation across mathematical reasoning, general knowledge, and medical domains, ESRL improves average accuracy by up to 31.7% relative to the base model and 16.6% relative to the strongest test-time adaptation baseline. Notably, ESRL substantially reduces catastrophic forgetting and achieves the strongest final performance in continual learning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ESRL：在参数空间扰动锚策略构造策略群体，为每个策略采样一条轨迹并聚合成无标签的组相对信号来更新中心学生模型，用于持续测试时学习，在数学推理、常识与医学任务上优于测试时自适应基线并缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「群体自生成监督＋锚策略分块刷新」的机制可能缓解 latent 推理中自监督信号随策略漂移而坍缩、退化的风险，可供核查是否能迁移为 latent 状态更新的稳定监督与多假设贡献分配方案。
